$comment: kdreams observation watchlist. Observe-only: nothing in this repo places orders. pairs[] maps the same real-world event across venues; polymarketId is the Gamma conditionId, kalshiTicker is the Kalshi market ticker; a pair's polymarketTakerRate overrides fees.polymarketTakerRate because Polymarket sets taker rates per market. Fee rates are published venue schedules as of 2026-10 and must be re-verified before any edge claim. backtest.horizonMinutes bounds the maker proxy in wall-clock time (snapshots are irregular); retestMinTicks is how many post-freeze ticks a frozen hypothesis needs before it is graded; retestMinN is the smallest sample a spec metric may be graded on. A pair with a retired reason, a settled leg, or a leg with no two-sided quote for backtest.pairStaleHours (default 24) is dropped from the report and from what hypotheses may name; keep retired pairs listed so earlier specs still resolve.

pairs.name: house-2026-republican
pairs.note: Same outcome (Republican House control after the 2026 midterms). Resolution timing differs: Polymarket endDate 2026-11-04, Kalshi close 2027-02-01. Check both rule texts before any edge claim.
pairs.retired: 2026-11-04: both legs settled (Kalshi 05:02Z, Polymarket 09:57Z; Democrats won the House). Kept so earlier hypotheses still resolve; dropped from the collector extras.

pairs.name: house-2026-democratic
pairs.retired: 2026-11-04: both legs settled (Kalshi 05:02Z, Polymarket 13:06Z). Kept so earlier hypotheses still resolve; dropped from the collector extras.

pairs.name: fed-2026-12-hike25
pairs.note: Same outcome: both resolve on the FOMC statement for the 2026-12-08/09 meeting. Edge cases differ: a canceled meeting resolves Kalshi to 'maintains' at once but Polymarket only after the next meeting's end date; Polymarket rounds an off-grid change up to the next 25 bps. Polymarket taker rate 0.05 is this market's feeSchedule.rate from Gamma (gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets?condition_ids=...), checked 2026-11-04.

pairs.name: fed-2026-12-hold
pairs.note: Sibling bracket of fed-2026-12-hike25: Polymarket 'no change' and Kalshi 'Fed maintains rate' are the same outcome; same rules and fee notes.
